_source: Imperial College Department of Computing programme pages — BEng/MEng Computing (/computing/current-students/computing/) and Joint Mathematics and Computing (/computing/current-students/jmc/), accessed June 2026.
_note: BEng and MEng Computing share the same Year 1-3 content modules, so all content modules belong to both. JMC (Joint Maths & Computing) takes the CS core plus Year-3 computing electives, but NOT the computing-department mathematics modules (JMC students take Mathematics-department maths) nor the Year-1 systems/databases modules.
